definitions.DOG: A mammal, Canis familiaris or Canis lupus familiaris, that has been domesticated for thousands of years, of highly variable appearance due to human breeding.
definitions.CAT: An animal of the family Felidae:.
definitions.BIRD: A member of the class of animals Aves in the phylum Chordata, characterized by being warm-blooded, having feathers and wings usually capable of flight, and laying eggs.
definitions.FISH: A cold-blooded vertebrate animal that lives in water, moving with the help of fins and breathing with gills.
definitions.LION: A big cat, Panthera leo, native to Africa, India and formerly much of Europe.
definitions.TIGER: Panthera tigris, a large predatory mammal of the cat family, indigenous to Asia.
definitions.BEAR: A large omnivorous mammal, related to the dog and raccoon, having shaggy hair, a very small tail, and flat feet.
definitions.WOLF: The gray wolf, specifically all subspecies of the gray wolf (Canis lupus) that are not dingoes or dogs.
definitions.DEER: A ruminant mammal with antlers and hooves of the family Cervidae, or one of several similar animals from related families of the order Artiodactyla.
definitions.HORSE: Any of several animals related to Equus ferus caballus.
definitions.PIG: Any of several intelligent mammalian species of the genus Sus, having cloven hooves, bristles and a nose adapted for digging.
definitions.GOAT: A mammal, Capra aegagrus hircus, and similar species of the genus Capra.
definitions.SHEEP: A woolly ruminant of the genus Ovis.
definitions.DUCK: To quickly lower the head or body in order to prevent it from being struck by something.
definitions.GOOSE: Any of various grazing waterfowl of the family Anatidae, which have feathers and webbed feet and are capable of flying, swimming, and walking on land, and which are bigger than ducks.
definitions.SWAN: Any of various species of large, long-necked waterfowl, of genus Cygnus (bird family: Anatidae), most of which have white plumage.
definitions.EAGLE: Any of several large carnivorous and carrion-eating birds in the family Accipitridae, having a powerful hooked bill and keen vision.
definitions.HAWK: A diurnal predatory bird of the family Accipitridae, smaller than an eagle.
definitions.OWL: Any of various birds of prey of the order Strigiformes that are primarily nocturnal and have forward-looking, binocular vision, limited eye movement, and good hearing.
definitions.MOUSE: Any small rodent of the genus Mus.
definitions.RAT: A medium-sized rodent belonging to the genus Rattus.
definitions.BAT: Any of the flying mammals of the order Chiroptera, usually small and nocturnal, insectivorous or frugivorous.
definitions.APE: A primate of the clade Hominoidea, generally larger than monkeys and distinguished from them by having no tail.
definitions.LLAMA: A South American mammal of the camel family, Lama glama, used as a domestic beast of burden and a source of wool and meat.
definitions.CAMEL: A beast of burden, much used in desert areas, of the genus Camelus.
definitions.PONY: A small horse; specifically, any of several small breeds of horse under 14.2 hands at the withers.
definitions.BUCK: A male deer, antelope, or rabbit.
definitions.DOE: A female deer, rabbit, or hare.
definitions.CUB: A young bear, lion, fox, or wolf.
definitions.PUG: A small breed of dog with a wrinkled face and curled tail.
definitions.HEN: A female chicken (Gallus gallus), particularly a sexually mature one kept for its eggs.
definitions.MULE: The generally sterile male or female hybrid offspring of a male donkey and a female horse.
definitions.ELK: Any of various large species of deer such as the red deer, moose or wapiti (see usage notes).
definitions.MOOSE: The largest member of the deer family (Alces americanus, sometimes included in Alces alces), of which the male has very large, palmate antlers.
definitions.LYNX: Any of several medium-sized wild cats, mostly of the genus Lynx.
definitions.PUMA: The mountain lion or cougar, Puma concolor.
definitions.KOALA: A tree-dwelling marsupial, Phascolarctos cinereus, that resembles a small bear with a broad head, large ears and sharp claws, mainly found in eastern Australia.
definitions.BADGER: Any mammal of three subfamilies, which belong to the family Mustelidae: Melinae (Eurasian badgers), Mellivorinae (ratel or honey badger), and Taxideinae (American badger).
definitions.SKUNK: Any of various small mammals, of the family Mephitidae, native to North and Central America, having a glossy black with a white coat and two musk glands at the base of the tail for emitting a noxious smell as a defensive measure.
definitions.ROOK: A black bird of the crow family.
definitions.CROW: A large black bird known for its intelligence and cawing call.
definitions.DOVE: A bird of the pigeon family, symbol of peace.
definitions.LARK: A small songbird known for its melodious singing.
definitions.FINCH: A small seed-eating songbird with a short, stout bill.
definitions.JAY: A colorful, noisy bird of the crow family.
definitions.HERON: A large wading bird with long legs and a long neck.
definitions.CRANE: Any bird of the family Gruidae, large birds with long legs and a long neck which is extended during flight.
definitions.IBIS: A large wading bird with a long, curved bill.
definitions.SWIFT: A fast-flying bird similar to a swallow.
definitions.ROBIN: A small songbird with a reddish-breast.
definitions.SNIPE: A wading bird with a very long, slender bill.
definitions.TERN: A seabird resembling a gull, with a forked tail.
definitions.PUFFIN: A colorful seabird known for its nesting habits.
definitions.ELEPHANT: A mammal of the order Proboscidea, having a trunk, and two large ivory tusks jutting from the upper jaw.
definitions.GIRAFFE: A ruminant, of the genus Giraffa, of the African savannah with long legs and highly elongated neck, which make it the tallest living animal; yellow fur patterned with dark spots, often in the form of a network; and two or more short, skin-covered horns, so-called; strictly speaking the horn-like projections are ossicones.
definitions.KANGAROO: A member of the Macropodidae family of large marsupials with strong hind legs for hopping, native to Australia.
definitions.PENGUIN: Any of several flightless sea birds, of order Sphenisciformes, found in the Southern Hemisphere, marked by their usual upright stance, walking on short legs, and (generally) their stark black and white plumage.
definitions.DOLPHIN: A carnivorous aquatic mammal in one of several families of order Cetacea, famed for its intelligence and occasional willingness to approach humans.
definitions.WHALE: Any of several species of large sea mammals of the infraorder Cetacea.
definitions.SHARK: A scaleless, predatory fish of the superorder Selachimorpha, with a cartilaginous skeleton and 5 to 7 gill slits on each side of its head.
definitions.TURTLE: Any land or marine reptile of the order Testudines, characterised by a protective shell enclosing its body.
definitions.RABBIT: A mammal of the family Leporidae, with long ears, long hind legs and a short, fluffy tail.
definitions.HAMSTER: Any of various Old-World rodent species belonging to the subfamily Cricetinae.
definitions.LEOPARD: Panthera pardus, a large wild cat with a spotted coat native to Africa and Asia, especially the male of the species (in contrast to leopardess).
definitions.CHEETAH: A distinctive member (Acinonyx jubatus) of the cat family, slightly smaller than the leopard, but with proportionately longer limbs and a smaller head.
definitions.PANTHER: Any of various big cats with black fur; most especially, the black-coated leopard of India.
definitions.GORILLA: The largest of the apes, native to the forests of central Africa, and known for their trait of knuckle-walking.
definitions.CHIMPANZEE: A species of great ape in the genus Pan, native to Africa, and believed by biologists to be the closest extant relative to humans.
definitions.ORANGUTAN: An arboreal anthropoid ape genus Pongo consisting of two species, Pongo pygmaeus of Borneo and Pongo abelii of Sumatra, having a shaggy reddish-brown coat, long arms, and no tail.
definitions.BABOON: An Old World monkey of the genus Papio, having dog-like muzzles and large canine teeth, cheek pouches, a short tail, and naked callosities on the buttocks.
definitions.MONKEY: Any member of the clade Simiiformes not also of the clade Hominoidea containing humans and apes, from which they are usually, but not universally, distinguished by smaller size, a tail, and cheek pouches.
definitions.LEMUR: Any strepsirrhine primate of the infraorder Lemuriformes, superfamily Lemuroidea, native only to Madagascar and some surrounding islands.
definitions.SLOTH: Laziness; slowness in the mindset; disinclination to action or labour.
definitions.PLATYPUS: A semi-aquatic, egg-laying monotreme mammal with a bill resembling that of a duck, that has a mole-like body, a tail resembling that of a beaver, a waterproof pelt, and flat webbed feet — males have poisonous spurs on the inside of the back legs; Ornithorhynchus anatinus.
definitions.ECHIDNA: Any of the species of small spined monotremes in family Tachyglossidae, the four extant species of which are found in Australia and southern New Guinea.
definitions.WALLABY: Any of several species of marsupial; usually smaller and stockier than kangaroos.
definitions.WOMBAT: Any of several herbivorous, burrowing marsupials, of the family Vombatidae, mainly found in southern and eastern Australia.
definitions.BANDICOOT: A small Australian marsupial with a distinctive long snout, of the family Peramelidae.
definitions.QUOKKA: A cat-sized marsupial, Setonix brachyurus, of southwestern Australia.
definitions.DINGO: Canis lupus dingo, a wild dog native to Australia.
definitions.BILBY: Australian desert marsupial (Macrotis lagotis), with distinctive large ears and approximately the size of a rabbit.
definitions.JAGUAR: A carnivorous spotted large cat native to South and Central America, Panthera onca.
definitions.HYENA: Any of the medium-sized to large feliform carnivores of the subfamily Hyaeninae (genera Hyaena and Crocuta), native to Africa and Asia and noted for the sound similar to laughter which they can make if excited.
definitions.ZEBRA: Any of three species of genus Equus: E.
definitions.ANTELOPE: Any of several African mammals of the family Bovidae distinguished by hollow horns, which, unlike deer, they do not shed.
definitions.GAZELLE: An antelope of either of the genera Gazella (mostly native to Africa) or Procapra (native to Asia), capable of running at high speeds for long periods.
definitions.MEERKAT: Suricata suricatta, a small carnivorous mammal of the mongoose family, from the Kalahari Desert, known for its habit of standing on its hind legs.
definitions.OTTER: An aquatic or marine carnivorous mammal in the subfamily Lutrinae of the family Mustelidae, which also includes weasels, polecats, badgers, and others.
definitions.BEAVER: A semiaquatic rodent of the genus Castor, having a wide, flat tail and webbed feet.
definitions.SQUIRREL: Any of the rodents of the family Sciuridae distinguished by their large bushy tail.
definitions.CHIPMUNK: A squirrel-like rodent of the genus Tamias, native mainly to North America.
definitions.RACCOON: A nocturnal omnivore native to North America, typically with a mixture of gray, brown, and black fur, a mask-like marking around the eyes and a striped tail; Procyon lotor.
definitions.ARMADILLO: Any of the burrowing mammals covered with bony, jointed, protective plates, order Cingulata, found in the Americas, especially in South America.
definitions.OPOSSUM: Any American marsupial of the family Didelphidae.
definitions.WALRUS: A large Arctic marine mammal related to seals and having long tusks, tough, wrinkled skin, and four flippers, Odobenus rosmarus.
definitions.SEAL: A pinniped (Pinnipedia), particularly an earless seal (true seal) or eared seal.
definitions.MANATEE: Any of several plant-eating marine mammals, of family Trichechidae, found in tropical regions.
definitions.DUGONG: A plant-eating aquatic marine mammal, of the genus Dugong, found in tropical regions.
definitions.NARWHAL: Monodon monoceros, an Arctic cetacean that grows to about 20 feet (6 meters) long, the male having a single horn-like tusk, a twisted, pointed canine tooth that projects forward.
definitions.ORCA: A sea mammal (Orcinus orca) related to dolphins and porpoises, commonly called the killer whale.
definitions.BELUGA: A cetacean, Delphinapterus leucas, found in the Arctic Ocean.
definitions.STINGRAY: Any of various large, venomous rays, of the orders Rajiformes and Myliobatiformes, having a barbed, whiplike tail.
definitions.OCTOPUS: Any of several marine molluscs of the family Octopodidae, having no internal or external protective shell or bone (unlike the nautilus, squid and cuttlefish) and eight arms each covered with suckers.
definitions.SQUID: Any of several carnivorous marine cephalopod mollusks, of the order Teuthida, having a mantle, eight arms, and a pair of tentacles.
definitions.LOBSTER: A crustacean of the Nephropidae family, dark green or blue-black in colour turning bright red when cooked, with a hard shell and claws, which is used as a seafood.
definitions.CRAB: A crustacean of the infraorder Brachyura, having five pairs of legs, the foremost of which are in the form of claws, and a carapace.
definitions.SHRIMP: Any of many swimming, often edible crustaceans, chiefly of the infraorder Caridea or the suborder Dendrobranchiata, with slender legs, long whiskers and a long abdomen.
definitions.STARFISH: Any of various asteroids or other echinoderms (not in fact fish) with usually five arms, many of which eat bivalves or corals by everting their stomach.
definitions.JELLYFISH: An almost transparent aquatic animal; any one of the acalephs, especially one of the larger species, having a jellylike appearance.
definitions.CORAL: A hard substance made of the limestone skeletons of marine polyps.
definitions.SPONGE: Any of various marine invertebrates, mostly of the phylum Porifera, that have a porous skeleton often of silica.
definitions.ANEMONE: Any plant of the genus Anemone, of the Ranunculaceae (or buttercup) family, such as the windflower.
definitions.FROG: A small tailless amphibian of the order Anura that typically hops.
definitions.TOAD: An amphibian, a kind of frog (order Anura) with shorter hindlegs and a drier, wartier skin, many in family Bufonidae.
definitions.NEWT: A small lizard-like amphibian in the family Salamandridae that lives in the water as an adult.
definitions.SALAMANDER: A long, slender, chiefly terrestrial amphibian of the order Caudata, superficially resembling a lizard.
definitions.LIZARD: Any reptile of the order Squamata that is not a snake, usually having four legs, external ear openings, movable eyelids and a long slender body and tail.
definitions.SNAKE: A legless reptile of the sub-order Serpentes with a long, thin body and a fork-shaped tongue.
definitions.TORTOISE: Any of various land-dwelling reptiles, of the family Testudinidae or the order Testudines , whose body is enclosed in a shell (carapace plus plastron).
definitions.IGUANA: A green iguana (Iguana iguana), a large tropical American lizard often kept as a pet.
definitions.GECKO: Any lizard of the family Gekkonidae.
definitions.CHAMELEON: A small to mid-size reptile, of the family Chamaeleonidae, and one of the best known lizard families able to change color and project its long tongue.
definitions.PYTHON: A type of large constricting snake.
definitions.COBRA: Any of various venomous snakes of the family Elapidae.
definitions.VIPER: A venomous snake in the family Viperidae.
definitions.DRAGON: A legendary serpentine or reptilian creature.
definitions.PHOENIX: A mythological bird, said to be the only one of its kind, which lives for 500 years and then dies by burning to ashes on a pyre of its own making, ignited by the sun.
definitions.UNICORN: A mythical beast resembling a horse or deer with a single, straight, spiraled horn projecting from its forehead.
definitions.GRIFFIN: A mythical beast having the body of a lion and the wings and head of an eagle.
definitions.PEGASUS: A winged horse fabled to have sprung from the body of Medusawhen she was slain.
